sections.title: Currency definitions, money, and tax
sections.summary: Start with the supported currency table and `Money`, which stores integer minor units alongside a currency code. Addition rejects mixed currencies. Tax is rounded per line, with five-rappen increments for CHF. Check negative halfway values and the JPY and KWD scales alongside the unit tests.

sections.title: Invoice validation and totals
sections.summary: Invoices carry a currency, and validation checks each line price against it. Totals start at zero in the invoice currency and add net and tax amounts with the same currency. The tests cover EUR totals, JPY totals, and mixed-currency rejection.

sections.title: Database migration and persistence
sections.summary: Migration 004 backfills existing invoices as EUR, drops the temporary default, renames the line-price column, and adds a nullable customer preference. Follow the invoice store’s read and write paths to verify that they reconstruct each line with the stored invoice currency.

sections.title: HTTP currency selection and API contract
sections.summary: Invoice creation chooses the request currency, then the customer preference, then the configured default. The routes accept `unit_price_minor`, return currency-labelled totals and `gross_minor`, and expose `GET /currencies`. Compare the OpenAPI schema with the checked-in types and handlers, especially the response fields and currency list. The route tests exercise the fallback cases individually.

sections.title: Currency formatting and PDF output
sections.summary: The renamed formatter uses each currency’s symbol and decimal scale. PDFs add a currency heading and use the same formatter as the HTTP response. Compare the EUR and JPY snapshots for the resulting output.

sections.title: Structured logging and configuration
sections.summary: The logger emits JSON lines to stderr, filters by `LOG_LEVEL`, and attaches request IDs on invoice routes. Review the mutual imports between the process logger and configuration for initialization order. The logger tests cover serialization, filtering, and inherited fields.

sections.title: Release script and test tooling
sections.summary: The release script becomes executable and enables `set -eu` before tagging and pushing. The package bumps Vitest, and the smoke test exercises health and missing routes through the test helper. Its health handler is registered inside the test.

sections.title: Logo asset
sections.summary: The binary logo file changed. Open the asset in the browser to compare it visually.
